replies.author: Dr. Lei
replies.content:
Mr. Rossel Banji is organizing a Hackathon workshop, and he is wondering if anyone would be interested in giving a 30-min or 1 hour workshop on any topic related to Trustworthy AI. I am including some information about the workshop below, but please let me know if you are available to do the workshop ASAP and by tomorrow (Monday), and I will put you in touch with him:

Date/Time:

Saturday: 11/14
5-5:30 PM for 30 minute workshop OR
5-6 PM (if they want hour long)

OR

Sunday: 11/15
10-10:30 AM for 30 minute workshop OR
10-11 AM (if they want hour long)

Content:

Regarding the session’s content, you have complete freedom to choose the content and structure you would like to cover.
You also have full flexibility in how you choose to structure your time (30 min slot or a 1 hour slot). You are welcome to present in whatever format works best for you. Our only expectation is that the session is engaging and interactive for the participants.

To ensure everything runs smoothly, we will have 2 volunteers assigned to your room. They will be on hand to help manage the attendees, take photos, and assist you with anything else you might need so your PhD students can focus entirely on your session.

Workshop title could be: xAI, Trustworthy AI

For example, the session could be a 30 minute introduction to xAI.
With an example of Lime and Shap.
